"""Reuse immutable prior local byte proofs; still verify remote tree and new raw bytes."""
import sys,os,json,hashlib,subprocess,traceback
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from mod_nailong.tools import master_git_remote as remote
base='c31746182dc8107663580331813869b48b638666';commit,batch=sys.argv[1:3]
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',commit+'^{commit}'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()
prior=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/high131-local-tree-proofs/{base}.json');assert prior['status']=='verified' and prior['machine_id']==machine_id() and prior['commit']==base
old_index=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':mod_nailong/data/fullsize-files.json'],cwd=ROOT))
assert set(prior['blobs'])==set(old_index['outputs'])
def verified_tree(actual_commit='HEAD',root=ROOT,index=None):
 assert actual_commit==commit and index is not None
 assert all(index['outputs'].get(k)==v for k,v in old_index['outputs'].items()),'Prior indexed originals changed'
 rows=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','-l',commit,'--','mod_nailong/assets/generated_fullsize'],cwd=ROOT).decode().splitlines()
 tree={}
 for row in rows:
  meta,path=row.split('\t',1);mode,kind,blob,size=meta.split();tree[path]=(kind,blob,int(size))
 blobs={};pending=[]
 for digest,entry in sorted(index['outputs'].items()):
  kind,blob,size=tree[entry['path']];assert kind=='blob' and size==entry['bytes']
  if digest in prior['blobs']:
   assert blob==prior['blobs'][digest];blobs[digest]=blob
  else:pending.append((digest,entry,blob))
 process=subprocess.Popen(['git','cat-file','--batch'],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
 try:
  for digest,entry,expected in pending:
   process.stdin.write((commit+':'+entry['path']+'\n').encode());process.stdin.flush();head=process.stdout.readline().decode().split();assert head==[expected,'blob',str(entry['bytes'])]
   sha=hashlib.sha256();left=entry['bytes']
   while left:
    block=process.stdout.read(min(left,1048576));assert block;sha.update(block);left-=len(block)
   assert process.stdout.read(1)==b'\n' and sha.hexdigest()==digest;blobs[digest]=expected
 finally:process.stdin.close();process.stdout.close();assert process.wait()==0
 assert len(blobs)==index['count']
 receipt['local_tree_validation']={'method':'Prior actual SHA256/size proof reused only after exact immutable blob/path/size match; every new Git PNG streamed and SHA256/size verified','prior_commit':base,'prior_local_proof_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/f'runtime/high131-local-tree-proofs/{base}.json'),'prior_actual_verified_at_utc':prior['verified_at_utc'],'reused_local_byte_proofs':len(blobs)-len(pending),'new_streamed_Git_PNGs':len(pending),'new_streamed_Git_bytes':sum(e['bytes'] for _,e,_ in pending),'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
 return commit,blobs
remote.verify_tree=verified_tree
receipt={'machine_id':machine_id(),'commit':commit,'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'process_id':os.getpid(),'status':'running'};out=ROOT/f'runtime/master-readback-{batch}.json';write_json(out,receipt)
lock=ROOT/'runtime/master-git-readback.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY);os.write(fd,str(os.getpid()).encode());os.close(fd)
try:
 result=remote.verify_remote(commit);receipt.update(status='verified',distinct_outputs=result['distinct_outputs'],original_png_bytes=result['original_png_bytes'],completed_at_utc=utc_now())
except BaseException:receipt.update(status='failed',error=traceback.format_exc(),completed_at_utc=utc_now());raise

 write_json(out,receipt);assert lock.read_text()==str(os.getpid());lock.unlink()
